errors.text: The imposed Ti content below 15 at.% contradicts the nominally equimolar CoCrFeNiTi composition, which contains 20 at.% Ti and therefore changes the target alloy.
The proposed 40 h milling at 250 rpm substantially conflicts with the target 1–6 h at 400 rpm and risks contamination, phase decomposition, or excessive cold welding.

The claimed sintering strain-rate limit, cooling-rate threshold, and Ti threshold are unsupported by the cited evidence, and the requested thermal-expansion/displacement-rate constraint is not meaningfully incorporated.

A single 10 mN nanoindentation measurement, even when paired with TEM grain-size verification, cannot separate Hall–Petch strengthening from solute strengthening without composition-controlled or grain-size-controlled comparison specimens.
